opening.argument: The speaker promotes creating a StrongBlock node as a passive-income investment, stating that it costs 10 STRONG and that estimated rewards should return that cost in roughly 100 days. He frames the opportunity around earning passive income, offers assistance with creating a node, and explains that viewers need MetaMask, ETH gas, and a recurring $14.95 fee. He further presents reinvesting rewards into another node or withdrawing them. Those concrete instructions and the unusually strong repayment framing amount to active solicitation, even though he calls the opportunity risky and urges viewers to research it.

citations.quote: creating a blockchain node and earning rewards. So this is one thing I love, is earning a passive income.
roughly within 100 days you should get your 10 strong back between 100 and 109 days
what you'll need is a Metamask wallet, you'll also need to pay a monthly fee of $14.95 and you can do that with ETH from your MetaMask wallet
you can obviously reinvest that and buy another node or you can withdraw it
